proposals.name: Clear Vigil
proposals.why: A watch kept through the night is a vigil, and glass is the clearest thing to keep one with: the chrome stays quiet, the panel stays out of the way, and the painting is what shows.

proposals.name: Stone and Glass
proposals.why: Tbilisi's glass bridge stands over the old stone of the town, and that meeting of modern clarity and old craft is the work this panel does on every design.

proposals.name: The Glass Choir
proposals.why: Each guardian is one clear voice and glass rings when it is struck, so the panel is heard in one chord as well as seen.
